titulo.alumno: Connectors in an explanation · Cause, consequence and concession

intro: Part 3: connectors in an explanation. Compare the two clues and distinguish what the text says from what it only seems to suggest.

frases.estudio: Prisen steg, fordi efterspørgslen blev større.
frases.alumno: The price rose because demand increased.

frases.estudio: Alligevel fortsatte flere med at købe produktet.
frases.alumno: Even so, several people kept buying the product.

texto: «Fordi» introduces a cause with a clause; «derfor» presents a consequence and, when it opens a main clause, triggers inversion. «Selvom» presents a difficulty that does not invalidate the main idea.
Compare the two clues and distinguish what the text says from what it only seems to suggest.
